method: chronological five-observed-stat-game mean threshold and smoothed empirical frequency; position-filtered, includes recorded zeros; NOT sportsbook-line calibration
leakage_policy: Each prediction uses only earlier games for the same player and market
limitations: Recorded zero production is retained, but missing weekly rows and missing participation cannot be classified without snaps/injury evidence. Synthetic thresholds, not posted odds or real SGP prices; no opponent, joint-correlation, or market EV validation
